clips.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game sprite animation strip.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact character model sheet. Its white backdrop is only for viewing; your output MUST have a genuinely transparent background.
Character: the exact simple round green dome slime with two tiny dark dot eyes and a low small front lobe. Keep that identity and drawing style. Keep head, body, ears, face and appendages the same size and the SAME LEFT-facing near-side camera in all frames.
Rendering: flat unlit solid-color cartoon sprite, clean dark outlines. Two solid colors only: all body #70C747; all outline and eyes #231B15. No highlight or shadow region. No texture, gradients, shiny spots, soft shading or cast shadows.
Primary request: EXACTLY 2 sequential animation frames in ONE horizontal row for idle: breathing: frame 1 the exact reference shape; frame 2 only 5% lower and slightly wider, maintaining volume, base touching the same baseline.
Composition: 2 equal-width cells, no visible dividers. One complete character per cell. Neutral body height about 55% of cell height, neutral body width about 75% of cell width, same camera zoom throughout. Center each character's torso horizontally in its own cell. All grounded feet/bases touch one common baseline at 78% cell height. Ample clear transparent space between frames and outside all edges. Do not cut off feet, tusk, tail, ears, silhouette or outlines. No text, labels, frame borders, floor line, ground, dust, effects, other objects or watermark. The character always faces LEFT.

postprocessAuthorization: 이전 턴에서 승인한 Pillow 고정 팔레트 평탄화를 같은 스타일의 적용용 클립에 유지함.

postprocess.normalization: 클립마다 기준 포즈로 생성 줌을 통일. 한 클립 안에서는 공통 배율 사용. 슬라임 걷기는 면적 중간값으로 줌을 맞춰 눌림·늘어남 보존.

orientation.method: 각 정사각 프레임 내부만 수평 반전. 프레임 순서·알파·RGB 값을 그대로 유지.
